programs.description: Renowned scholars make predictions based on zodiac signs and also provide appropriate solutions to one's day-to-day problems.
A curated compilation of religious and sacred songs performed by various artists in devotion to Hindu deities is played back to back.
A renowned astrologer studies the movement and relative position of celestial objects and predicts the future for the 12 zodiac signs.
An astrologer studies horoscopes and predicts the future of the people while offering spiritual solutions to tackle the effects of planetary transitions.
